headline: Offers stable income from commodity and royalty earnings slices plus warrant upside, delivering low double-digit historical returns
reasoning: Lowe singles out the BetaShares ROL ETF as a concrete example of a royalty instrument accessible to individual investors on the ASX. It generates stable cash yield from earnings pieces of commodity and other royalty-paying companies, with attaching warrants providing upside exposure. Historical returns have been in the low double digits.
quote: If we look at even the beta shares ROL is the ticker. These are this is an instrument that it really focuses on that stable income from little earnings, earnings pieces that come out of primarily commodity companies. But they can also be even things as far as record labels. And what they look to do is to produce a stable income stream. And then oftentimes they have what they call attaching warrants. For us as investors, we do have that ability to get that upside potential. And historically they've been earning low double digit returns, which is very, very acceptable in this type of market condition.
episode_title: Chasing income? 10-12% yields come with a catch

headline: Persistent inflation and high bond yields creating a tough backdrop for traditional equities, with private companies showing consumer deterioration and no AI/mega-cap tailwind to lift the market
reasoning: Greg Lowe notes that the macro environment is difficult for traditional equities: inflation remains sticky, bond yields are elevated, and internal checks show private companies experiencing deterioration with the consumer slowing. Unlike the US, Australia lacks the mega-cap AI companies that could provide a structural lift.

headline: Caution warranted in real estate private credit given deteriorating conditions visible in private channel checks
reasoning: Lowe warns that private credit backed by real estate requires careful scrutiny, citing internal channel checks that show deterioration in the sector. He stresses the importance of understanding the underlying assets, whether they are asset-backed or cash-flow-backed instruments, and performing due diligence before investing. He expects the deterioration to flow through to returns.
quote: I think you do need to be wary of them because, again, in our private channel checks, we are certainly seeing deterioration and no doubt that that is going to flow through.
